Which would you personally pick on my budget?
If I were choosing for a tight budget, I’d personally pick the Queen 8"x8" Floor & Wall Tile.
At $14.82 per square foot ($79.00 per box), it gives you the exact same high-end 1/2" thickness, handcrafted quality, and long-lasting durability as our higher-priced cement tiles, but at nearly half the cost of many other patterns. The classic black-and-white design is incredibly versatile and looks far more expensive than it is.
Another great budget route is browsing our Sale collection, where select cement patterns are marked down, allowing you to get unique artisan designs for less.

Does the cheaper one have the same warranty as the pricier one?
Yes, all of our handcrafted cement tiles—regardless of whether they are a budget-friendly option like Queen or a higher-priced design—are built to the exact same high standards of quality, material thickness (1/2"), and durability.
Because cement tiles are handcrafted from natural mineral-based materials, long-term performance and protection come from proper installation and sealing rather than a separate manufacturer warranty tier.
To ensure your tiles stay fully protected against stains and moisture, we strongly urge sealing all of our cement tiles with Zeus' Tile Sealer by Tile Armor upon installation. When properly sealed and maintained with pH-neutral cleaners, both options will perform reliably and look gorgeous for decades!
